annotations.title: Review legal text for unsupported quotes and claims

description: Independently review legal text produced by ANY AI vendor for the structural red-flags behind fabrication risk: (1) orphan quotations — a quoted span with no citation in its sentence, the citation sentence after it, or its footnote; (2) uncited propositions — law stated as established (a holding cue or a settled-law phrase such as 'it is well established') with no such citation; (3) court mismatch — the text names one circuit, the cite another; (4) impossible date — a citation year in the future or before its reporter series began; (5) court/reporter mismatch — a court and reporter that cannot both be right; (6) a case name and cite matching one publicly identified as non-existent in Mata v. Avianca (S.D.N.Y. 2023). Recognizes full and short-form cites (Id., supra, Westlaw/Lexis, U.S.C., C.F.R., state codes, court rules) and footnotes; triggers in English and Spanish. Returns each flag with the exact passage, its offsets, a severity and a plain structural observation, FOR YOUR REVIEW. It is a neutral referee: it never tells you the answer is right or wrong, never adjudicates, and abstains (returns no flags) on any fault rather than fabricating one. Deterministic and local — no external lookup. (Live case-citation existence checking against CourtListener runs on the website verifier at /verify; multi-model cross-validation runs in TrustAI's document-analysis engine and the licensed pilot — neither runs on this load-safe tool.)
